name: proofagent
description: ProofAgent Guardrail Enterprise for Claude Code: every prompt, tool call and tool result is checked by your company's own guardrail server, under your company's policies. Personal data is masked before Claude sees it and filled back in on your machine. Nothing is sent to ProofAgent's cloud.

nano_url.title: Your company's guardrail address
nano_url.description: From your ProofAgent invite link, for example https://guardrail.yourcompany.com

nano_key.title: Your personal key
nano_key.description: From your ProofAgent invite link. It identifies you and your team.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: strict: stop actions your company's policy blocks (default). warn: notify only.

reveal_on_screen.title: Show real values on my screen
reveal_on_screen.description: Claude's replies are drawn with the real values on your screen only; Claude keeps seeing placeholders
